events.intent: Make reviewer verdict collection parse Claude Code hard-wrapped AO_REVIEW JSON reliably (breaks inside strings and after punctuation), using the two real failing captures as fixtures.
boundaries: agent-orchestration reviewer.mjs parser, its unit tests, dist, CHANGELOG
checks: cd agent-orchestration && env -u TMUX node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/unit/*.test.mjs

artifacts: commit 4bdb9a6: reviewer verdict parser handles Markdown-rendered and hard-wrapped AO_REVIEW JSON
checks: lead rerun: agent-orchestration unit 724 tests, 720 pass, 0 fail, 4 skipped
report.evidence: Root cause found by worker: Claude Code renders reviewer output as Markdown, which strips backslashes from \" and \u escapes, in addition to hard-wrapping. Both real failing captures (briefs/TM-444.review-1.raw.txt, briefs/TM-224.review-1.raw.txt) are inline verbatim fixtures and now parse.
risks: Prose containing literal ","key": or "] could be read as JSON structure; the post-parse schema check then refuses rather than records a wrong verdict
Prose may differ by one space at a wrap point; verdict, severity and file fields are exact
